rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is suitable or right for a purpose or occasion.

example.english: This outfit is perfectly suitable for wearing to work.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 saam1 ngaam1 saai3 faan1 gung1 zoek3

rows.note: Use this when explicitly saying that something suits a particular person, purpose, or task.

example.english: This job is suitable for you.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 sik1 hap6 nei5

rows.note: Use this when judging whether a choice, time, place, or arrangement is appropriate.

example.english: This time is the most suitable for meeting.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 si4 gaan3 gin3 min6 zeoi3 hap6 sik1
